classes.CThrower:
Option Explicit
Public Sub Boom()
    Err.Raise vbObjectError + 7, "CThrower.Boom", "kaboom"
End Sub
Public Function Divide(ByVal a As Double, ByVal b As Double) As Double
    Divide = a / b
End Function
Public Function Guarded() As String
    On Error GoTo Bad
    Err.Raise 5
    Exit Function
Bad:
    Guarded = "guarded " & Err.Number
End Function

probes.name: propagate_to_caller
probes.macro:
Private Function Inner() As Long
    Inner = 1 / 0
End Function

Private Function Middle() As String
    Dim x As Long
    x = Inner()
    Middle = "not here"
End Function

Private Function ToLabel() As String
    On Error GoTo Handler
    Err.Raise 11
    ToLabel = "skipped"
Continue:
    ToLabel = ToLabel & "continued " & Err.Number
    Exit Function
Handler:
    ToLabel = "handled;"
    Resume Continue
End Function

Private Function ErrorInHandler() As String
    On Error GoTo H
    Err.Raise 5
    Exit Function
H:
    ErrorInHandler = "in handler;"
    Err.Raise 6
End Function

Private Function LoopWithHandler() As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    For i = 1 To 4
        On Error Resume Next
        Dim x As Double
        x = 10 / (i - 2)
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "e" & Err.Number & ";" Else s = s & x & ";"
        Err.Clear
        On Error GoTo 0
    Next
    LoopWithHandler = s
End Function

Private Function NestedHandlers() As String
    On Error GoTo Outer
    Dim s As String
    s = Middle()
    NestedHandlers = s
    Exit Function
Outer:
    NestedHandlers = "outer caught " & Err.Number & " from " & Err.Source
End Function

Function Probe() As String
On Error Resume Next
Dim s As String
s = Middle()
Probe = Err.Number & "|" & s & "|" & Err.Description
End Function
